a:
STYLE: 1930s rubber hose cartoon, hand-inked cel animation look, original characters.
Thick uniform outline in dark plum #3D3346 on every shape, clean confident lines, no sketchy strokes.
Flat cel colors with at most one soft shade tone per color, no gradients on characters, no 3D rendering, no glossy plastic look; one small white highlight dot is allowed.
Characters: bendy rubber hose arms and legs with no elbows or knees, white four-finger cartoon gloves, big round shoes, pie-cut eyes (black ovals with a small wedge cut out), simple wide mouth, big head-to-body ratio.
Character colors are saturated: red #D2463C, blue #3E6DB5, yellow #F2C14E, cream #F4E6C8, glove white #FBF6EA.
Backgrounds and large props look like faded watercolor on paper in beige #CFAC8D, sand #D7BE97, dusty navy #4E546E, muted olive #8A9A6B, warm grey #907F77, and are LESS saturated than the characters.
Soft light from the top-left. No cast shadow on the ground. No text, letters or numbers anywhere.
Do not copy any existing cartoon or game character, logo, or scene.

Each item isolated on a flat solid #FF00FF magenta background (or transparent), full figure visible, nothing cropped, wide empty margin around every item, no ground line, no floor, no frame, no border, no shadow under the item.
Characters face the viewer at a slight high 3/4 angle unless a direction is given. "Side" always means facing RIGHT.

Exactly SIX isolated props in a 3-column by 2-row grid. Top row left to right: cottage, round tree, tall poplar. Bottom row left to right: low bush, low rock, brass wind-up key. Center each object in its own cell, with generous pure magenta gutters. Use a landscape canvas, all assets clearly readable and high resolution. Keep the bush and rock wide and low; do not add foliage or ground around the objects. No palette swatches. No faces on rock or bush. The round tree may have the sleepy face from the anchor. Keep each prop within its own grid cell.

small round-roofed cartoon cottage with a face-like front (two round windows as eyes), wobbly walls, chimney, ONE door placed exactly at the bottom center
round cartoon tree with a thick bendy trunk and a puffy cloud-like crown, sleepy face on the trunk optional
tall cartoon poplar tree, wavy trunk, stacked puffy crown
low round bush, wide and short, three puffy lobes
small smooth rounded rock, wide and low
a brass wind-up key, butterfly-shaped handle, standing upright, small sparkle, toy-like

Reference roles: image 1 is the primary project style anchor: match its plum ink, muted olive foliage, warm beige props and golden key. Image 2 is linework/animation-style reference only. Images 3 and 4 show faded scenic prop painting and staged perspective only. Never reproduce their characters, logos, writing or scenes. Use a perfectly flat pure #FF00FF background, no gradients or texture in the background. No ground shadow. No labels. Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game sprite sheet.
